baselinePolicy: Any changed baseline must include image diff artifacts and an accepted reviewStatus.
notes: Reviewed all twelve regenerated contact sheets covering React, Svelte, and Solid in light and dark themes.
The manual pass caught a missing Svelte checkbox mark and dropped React and Solid native input placeholders; both implementation defects were fixed before the accepted recapture.
The final 72-page browser matrix passed catalog-versus-clean-consumer computed-style parity, cross-framework recipe parity, and presentation-integrity probes with no failures.
Public state routes contain no QA harness controls; button, card, checkbox, switch, tabs, command, input, overlay, and table presentation checks are part of the accepted baseline.

The final Aside pass caught React production CSS retaining only a prefixed backdrop filter because the fallback declarations were ordered incorrectly; the source order, regression test, production build, and real rendered dialog were corrected and rechecked.
This review accepts the Tier 0 internal visual baseline. It does not claim independent external equivalence to another library or uniform hand-curation of every component in the 69-component catalog.
